verdict.rationale: NVIDIA documents CUDA Toolkit, CUDA Tile C++/cuTile Python, and Transformer Engine libraries as programmatic interfaces for GPU compute, which count as a documented API surface, but these are low-level GPU programming SDKs rather than a product-level public API designed for AI-native/agentic control, and probes for an OpenAPI/REST surface returned 404s. Missing for 10: an agent-oriented public API/CLI/SDK for orchestrating the product end-to-end, and any independent corroboration that AI agents actually drive the GPU via a documented API rather than just writing CUDA kernels.
